citation: History of Kane County / St. Charles Township early-settlement account, Gideon Young at Naperville in January 1835.
locator: J. T. Wheeler and Jerusha Young married at the home of Gideon Young, who then lived at Naperville
note: The exact name is independently placed in Naperville within months of the 1834 Chicago postal entry. Nearby but competing geography prevents treating the waiting letter as proof of a Chicago household.
